tasks.description: Checks every package of a resolved dependency tree against a license policy and recorded exceptions. Use when asked for a license compliance report on a dependency tree.
tasks.intent: Report license policy compliance for a resolved dependency tree.

tasks.description: Drafts an attribution document of runtime dependencies grouped by license with their copyright lines. Use when asked to draft an attribution or notices document for shipped dependencies.
tasks.intent: Draft an attribution document for runtime dependencies.

tasks.description: Lists denied, unrecognised and unapproved review licenses among distributed dependencies. Use when asked for the license policy violations in a dependency tree.
tasks.intent: List license policy violations among distributed dependencies.
